maddeler.t: From أَبُو (ʔabū, “father of”) + ظَبْي (ẓaby, “gazelle”), literally “father of a gazelle”.
g: Abu Dhabi (the capital city of the United Arab Emirates; the capital of Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates)
Abu Dhabi (an emirate of the United Arab Emirates, the largest of the seven emirates)
